The persons residing at the Property are individuals recovering from drug and alcohol addictions. These individuals have sought help through Renaissance Ranch’s substance abuse program in effort to achieve long- term sobriety. Therefore, these individuals are classified as disabled (or handicapped) under the American with Disabilities Act (“ADA”) and the Fair Housing Amendments Act (“FHAA”).
